assertions.name: Owned helper responsive, final public subpath served, repository root inaccessible
No horizontal overflow: desktop before interactions
Desktop 1200×900 DPR1 real first-screen screenshot, local fonts loaded
Keyboard ride popover, Escape/focus return, X and outside-click close; add is unique
Shared map/list thrill and cumulative height filters, keyboard filter and zero-match case
Ride/show/parade plan, correct categorized summary, keyboard reorder, completion, reload persistence, remove
No horizontal overflow: desktop after filters, popovers, ticket note and itinerary
All three ticket demo controls disclose no connected ticketing or charge
Clear plan updates empty state and persisted ids
No horizontal overflow: requested 1440x900
Additional requested 1440×900 desktop viewport
No horizontal overflow: mobile before interactions
No horizontal overflow: mobile with ride details open
No horizontal overflow: mobile after menu, map scroll, popover, tickets, filters and itinerary
Mobile 390×844: real screenshot, menu touch/keyboard/Escape, internal map scroll, keyboard ride, itinerary, tickets, shared filters and 44px controls
Reduced-motion preference disables map pops and add confetti
Corrupt stored plan recovers safely and remains usable
Unavailable storage falls back to in-memory plan with honest warning
No external runtime requests
Independent static export and final model-subpath validation
Zero browser console, page, request and HTTP errors in all contexts

visualReview.method: 通过 view 工具实际打开最终 desktop.png 与 mobile.png，并打开 rides.png、tickets.png、mobile-plan.png 检查下方内容。
visualReview.desktop: 奶油底、葡萄紫圆体标题、糖果四区地图形成清晰层次；完整原创地标、入口和筛选按钮可辨识。调整首屏密度，移开柠檬区骑乘点并消除标题/塔顶重叠。
visualReview.mobile: 390×844 下标题、正文、CTA 和导航无横向溢出；地图使用明确提示的内部横向滚动，右侧区域并非被丢弃。移动行程按行换行，完成框及44px排序/删除控件清晰。
visualReview.sections: 九张卡片间距、区色和图标统一；票价对比及演示声明清晰；移动行程完成态与排序控件未重叠。
refinements: 修复菜单点击 SVG 后目标节点脱离导致立即关闭的问题，并加强桌面隐藏选择器。
禁止截图中途动画残影；保留实际动效并让截图捕获最终状态。
移除负间距遮挡，使地图底部入口条完整显示；移动端滑动提示前置。

preview.review: 实际打开新生成的 out\preview.png；字体、四区地图、入口、筛选与主标题一致，没有空白或错误页面。
